name: e2e_pdf_methods_excerpt_c2: mix
description: UNROUTED. Built by assay2chip/stages/s6_build.py from partition.json: op 18 mix -> trap_chamber 'mix_18'. mix share one board; 3 of the 6 ports allowed at demo scale; 13% of the envelope 30 x 20 mm (demo envelope), ONE fluidic layer at ONE 0.3 mm etch depth, base and lid 0.5 / 1 mm. COP (Zeonor 1060R) because hot_embossing route. SIZED FROM THE LOAD, never from the paper's tube volumes (assay2chip/README.md, 'Bench volumes do not transfer'): mix_18 from every op on this chip carries a stream, so op(s) 18 became its one place, at the smallest footprint a channel can attach to (1.40 mm a side). PLACEMENT: parts sit in flow order in 1 row(s) (left to right), spread across the usable 23.6 x 13.6 mm so the slack between them is routing corridor. Total chain length 24.3 mm, crossing risk 0, nothing rotated; every feature keeps at least 0.4 mm to its neighbours and to the chip edge. PORTS: 3 (inlet_1, outlet_1, reagent_in), each over a PORT PAD the registry sized, so the bore opens entirely onto cut area and the port-overlap rule in tools/check_chip_spec.py passes. Inlets and outlets are on opposite edges, which is what keeps the layout planar in one layer, and no two ports are closer than 5 mm. CHANNELS BETWEEN PARTS ARE DELIBERATELY EMPTY: S7 routes them from assay2chip/work/<id>/connections_e2e_pdf_methods_excerpt_c2.json. Until it has run, a chamber here is unconnected on purpose, and every rule that needs a channel - channel width against capsule diameter, channel crossings, protocol targets - can only be checked after S7. Parts sized by assay2chip/parts/registry.py. RISKS carried from sizing: Z TOLERANCE: the gap is 25 um and published z tolerance on these processes is +/-20 um, which is +/-80% of it, so the weir could close or leak outright. blocks.json calls this the biggest unknown in the retention scheme: coupon 21, 24 and 27 um gaps before committing. If it fails, the lever is capsule size (tunable 35-260 um), which buys a proportionally larger gap.; flow distribution across a wide weir is explicitly NOT scale-free (blocks.json target_envelope.not_scale_free); this crest is 1.4 mm wide.

layers.note: the ONE fluidic layer, at the one etch depth (contracts/blocks.json envelope.max_depth_mm = 0.3 mm)
bonded lid; the ports are drilled through it onto their pads

chambers.note: depth weir at the outlet: 25 um gap in z under the lid, 275 um crest (300 um etch depth minus the gap), 200 um thick in plane. Volume is the box minus the crest.
